title: syzygium austrosinense
intro: Syzygium austrosinense, commonly known as the Taiwanese cherry or Chinese hawthorn, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. It is a shrub or small tree with edible fruits, rich in nutrients and antioxidants. The health benefits of Syzygium austrosinense include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
